## 更新内容 / Changes

Codex 与 Claude 现在共用分页对话查看器。Codex 会话可以从列表中打开并分页阅读；支持正文搜索、工具调用 / 结果和当前页 Markdown 复制 / 下载。新版 Codex 分段历史会沿 `history_base` 逐段验证；祖先缺失、边界不一致或文件变化时拒绝显示不完整内容。查看过程保持只读。

会话管理新增可登记的外部只读 Codex 会话来源，支持从其他 `CODEX_HOME` 搜索、查看，并单向导入普通 JSONL 会话到受管 Codex 实例。来源目录不加入账号配置或可写目标；导入预览与提交会复核来源登记、目录身份和会话文件清单。来源停用、移除、替换或内容变化会阻止过期预览提交。导入目标已有会话时保留备份。

跨实例复制 / 同步仍不迁移依赖 `history_base` 和 SQLite 数据库组的分页会话；预览会列明并跳过这些记录，避免只复制 JSONL 后形成残缺对话。

Codex and Claude now use the same paginated transcript viewer. Codex conversations can be opened from the list and read page by page, with text search, tool calls / results, and current-page Markdown copy / download. Newer paginated histories are followed through `history_base` with each segment verified; missing ancestors, inconsistent boundaries, or changed files fail closed instead of showing an incomplete transcript. Viewing remains read-only.

Session management can register external read-only Codex homes to search, view, and one-way import ordinary JSONL conversations into a managed Codex instance. External homes are not added to client configuration or writable targets. Preview and commit recheck the source registration, directory identity, and rollout inventory; disabling, removing, replacing or changing a source prevents a stale preview from committing. Existing target conversations are backed up before import.

Cross-instance copy / sync still skips paginated conversations that depend on `history_base` and the SQLite database group. The preview lists these conversations as skipped to avoid creating incomplete history by copying JSONL alone.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。正在运行的管理器和实例可以继续工作；安装新版前请等待管理器退出，或直接打开独立的新版本应用。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. The current manager and instances can keep running; wait for the manager to exit before replacing it, or open the independent new-version app directly. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本完成 TypeScript 类型检查、会话目录扫描与查看、同步保护及来源文件不变性回归。发布后补充与此版本精确对应的来源提交、GitHub Actions 构建记录、版本标签和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

This version is checked with TypeScript typechecking and regression tests for session discovery, transcript viewing, sync protection, and source immutability. After publication, this section will link the exact source commit, matching GitHub Actions run, version tag, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
